summary: community.hrobot also deprecates plans[].month in snapshot plan info, password_mode=set-to-random in storagebox_subaccount, and several subaccount return values.
questions: Can I use password_mode=set-to-random with Hetzner's new API?

answer_card.title: community.hrobot subaccount deprecations
answer_card.answer_md:
- `storagebox_snapshot_plan_info`: `plans[].month` deprecated (always `null`).
- `storagebox_subaccount`: `password_mode=set-to-random` deprecated, removed in 3.0.0; only works with the legacy API.
- `storagebox_subaccount` / `_info`: `homedirectory`, `samba`, `ssh`, `external_reachability`, `webdav`, `readonly`, `createtime`, `comment` (and `accountid`) return values deprecated for new-API names.
